items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: They've changed it now, I understand. Crozat is what it's called now, but that's, it used to be Franklin.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was waiting for Gypsy Shafer. So on our way back, the second street, the next street behind Basin used to be called Franklin. They've changed it now, I understand.

Crozat is what it's called now, but that's, it used to be Franklin. So we got, we walked back, I met Tony Perini, but I didn't know him that day. Yeah. He used to come around and listen to him. And Tony Jackson played a marvelous piano, he could sing like a woman. And when I was at Omaha, he wrote Pretty Baby, when I was at Omaha I picked up a copy of music of Some Sweet Day, had to go to color shows. See up in New York, people that had to go to color shows, they couldn't go to white. Beautiful number. Some sweet…
